$comment: Sundays block (L-065), solemnities and feasts of the Lord in the proper of time, including the Triduum and the Easter Vigil, keyed by Lectio celebration id. Year A and the readings that are the same every year are imported from LitCal (import/litcal/sundays-celebrations.json). PalmSun, EasterVigil and MaryMotherOfGod were converted from the same pinned LitCal files by the same rules as the importer, which cannot read them: the procession gospel is the `procession` Mass; the Vigil readings use reading-1…7/psalm-1…7, `epistle`, and psalm-8 for the psalm after the epistle; the Mary, Mother of God psalm comes from OLM 1981 because LitCal's "Psalm 66 (67)" does not parse. Everything LitCal lacks (most of Years B and C) is filled from the OLM 1981 structure, cited by OLM lectionary number. Every entry is provisional until checked against the Kenyan Lectionary (docs/decisions/011-lectionary-source.md).
